raw_comment:
Climate change - Will you be affected by fires?
I notice that most of the United Stares is experiencing a severe drought. I especially noticed how NY has been experiencing moderate drought but that was enough to start fires throughout the state. I wonder if there is any way to reverse this and if drought will continue to occur due to climate change. I also wonder if there will be any new laws placed to avoid the increasing amount of climate change. This affects my community and I because it can cause a danger for us as the drought increases.
